sloka: भुवनम् स्वम् गमिष्यामि स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु परंतप ।इतो वसति धर्मात्मा शरभङ्गः प्रतापवान् ॥३-४-२०॥
transliteration: bhuvanam svam gamiṣyāmi svasti vo'stu paraṁtapa ।ito vasati dharmātmā śarabhaṅgaḥ pratāpavān ॥3-4-20॥

translations.english: O dear, there lives Sarabhanga, a righteous sage, comparable to the Sun, at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here. Go to him at once. He will bless you with your wellbeing.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! मुझे गडढे में डाल तुम मजे में चले जाओ । मरे हुए राक्षसा को जमीन में गाड़ना, यह प्राचीन प्रथा हे
